bug_description: LoginForm.jsx fails to handle empty password inputs gracefully, throwing an unhandled exception

expected_behavior.empty_password: Returns { ok: false, error: 'Password is required' }

implementation_evidence.fix_applied: Changed throw new Error() to return error object
implementation_evidence.test_coverage: Added 3 new test cases covering empty password, undefined password, and empty email verification
implementation_evidence.consistency_achieved: All validation errors now return same format: { ok: false, error: string }
